programme_facts.value: While tuition and fee estimates can look overwhelming, your net online tuition price provides a better estimate of how much money you’ll actually spend on your college degree. Your net price is the cost of tuition and fees subtracted by any college financial aid such as grants, scholarships, tuition waivers and other types of federal aid.
